| Source | Building Area (SF) |
|---|---|
| Rent Roll (XLSX) | 128,400 |
| CSV extract #1 (XLSX) | 133,750 |
| CSV extract #2 (XLSX, listed as "Kestrel Point Logistics Ctr") | 118,300 |
| Comparable Set Extract (PDF) | 121,900 |

**Answer:** The four sources give conflicting building-area figures for Kestrel Point Logistics Center — 128,400 SF (Rent Roll), 133,750 SF (one CSV record), 118,300 SF (another CSV record, listed under a slightly abbreviated name "Kestrel Point Logistics Ctr"), and 121,900 SF (Comparable Set Extract PDF). These four values differ by as much as ~15,450 SF (about 13%), so the sources do **not** agree — there is no single consistent building area figure across the documents, and this discrepancy should be flagged/reconciled before relying on any one number.
